b8de0e4d474e76c982a415968858fca44f1e540b.summary: CrowdStrike reports a cryptojacking campaign it calls Kiss-a-dog that targets exposed Docker and Kubernetes environments. Attackers used a host mount to escape containers, mined with XMRig through anonymous pool servers, and hid processes with kernel and user-mode rootkits. They also removed cloud monitoring agents, scanned for exposed Docker and Redis instances, and left a Redis backdoor. The report says the tools and techniques were previously associated with TeamTNT.
